rudderstack_expected_payload.description: Redis Stream uses the Redis Streams data structure for ordered, persistent message ingestion. The NewProducer constructor creates a Redis client connected to a Redis instance or cluster, and messages are produced using the XADD command which appends entries to a stream key. Each entry consists of field-value pairs derived from the event payload. Redis Streams provide built-in consumer group support for reliable message consumption.

connection.protocol: Redis wire protocol (RESP) over TCP, with optional TLS
connection.address: Redis instance address in host:port format (e.g., redis.example.com:6379)

authentication.mechanism: Redis AUTH command with optional username (Redis 6+ ACL) or password-only (Redis 5 and earlier)

tls.description: TLS can be enabled for encrypted Redis connections; required for managed Redis services

destination_config.stream: Required. The Redis stream key name to append messages to (e.g., 'rudder-events').
destination_config.address: Required. Redis server address in host:port format.
destination_config.password: Optional. Redis AUTH password for authentication.
destination_config.database: Optional. Redis logical database index. Default is 0.
destination_config.useTLS: Optional. Boolean flag to enable TLS encryption. Default is false.
destination_config.maxLen: Optional. Maximum stream length for XADD MAXLEN trimming. 0 means no trimming.
destination_config.approximateTrimming: Optional. Boolean flag to use approximate (~) MAXLEN trimming for better performance.

message_format.structure: Redis Stream entry with auto-generated ID and field-value pairs
message_format.entry_id: Auto-generated by Redis ('*' for server-assigned monotonic ID)

fields.userId: Extracted from the event JSON payload (gjson path 'userId')
fields.type: Event type (track, identify, page, screen, group, alias)
fields.payload: JSON-serialized message field from the event payload

message_format.encoding: JSON serialization via jsonrs.Marshal for the payload field
message_format.maxlen: Optional stream length trimming via XADD MAXLEN option

field_mappings.note: No Segment equivalent. Segment does not offer a Redis Streams destination. RudderStack implements Redis Stream as a dedicated stream destination type (REDIS_STREAM) using the Redis XADD command.
field_mappings.producer_routing: REDIS_STREAM destination name routes through streammanager.NewProducer switch to redisstream.NewProducer
field_mappings.stream_key: Derived from the destination config 'stream' field; serves as the Redis Stream key to append entries to
field_mappings.entry_id: Auto-generated by Redis using '*' (server-assigned monotonic ID combining millisecond timestamp and sequence number)
field_mappings.payload_field: The message field from the input JSON is extracted and JSON-serialized as the 'payload' field in the Redis Stream entry
field_mappings.userId_field: Extracted from the event JSON via gjson path 'userId'; stored as a separate field in the stream entry for efficient filtering
field_mappings.type_field: Event type (track, identify, page, screen, group, alias) stored as a separate field for consumer routing
field_mappings.timestamp_handling: Redis Stream entries receive a server-assigned monotonic ID; the event's original timestamp is preserved within the payload field
field_mappings.maxlen_trimming: Optional MAXLEN trimming prevents unbounded stream growth; approximate trimming (~) can be enabled for better performance
field_mappings.consumer_groups: Redis Streams natively support consumer groups (XREADGROUP) for reliable, distributed consumption with acknowledgment (XACK)
field_mappings.envelope_fields: RudderStack events include rudderId, originalTimestamp, sentAt, receivedAt — these are preserved within the JSON payload field

config_fields.Stream: Redis stream key name to append entries to (e.g., 'rudder-events')
config_fields.Address: Redis server address in host:port format (e.g., 'redis.example.com:6379')
config_fields.UseTLS: Boolean flag to enable TLS encryption
config_fields.MaxLen: Maximum stream length for XADD MAXLEN trimming (0 = no trimming)
config_fields.ApproximateTrimming: Boolean flag to use approximate (~) MAXLEN trimming

notes: Redis Stream is a RudderStack-unique stream destination. Segment does not offer a native Redis Streams destination in its catalog. RudderStack implements Redis Stream as a dedicated destination type (REDIS_STREAM) using the Redis Streams data structure (XADD command) for ordered, persistent message ingestion. Redis Streams provide built-in consumer group support, making them suitable for reliable event distribution to multiple downstream consumers. The producer uses the go-redis/v9 client library for Redis connectivity and supports optional TLS encryption, Redis 6+ ACL authentication, and configurable stream length trimming via MAXLEN. Each event is stored as a stream entry with separate userId and type fields for efficient filtering, plus the full event payload serialized as JSON in the 'payload' field. The destination is registered in the stream manager factory (services/streammanager/streammanager.go) and listed in the Custom Destination Manager's ObjectStreamDestinations array (router/customdestinationmanager/customdestinationmanager.go). Since there is no direct Segment equivalent, payload parity comparison is not applicable — this fixture documents RudderStack's Redis Stream payload format for regression testing and field-by-field validation.
